canonical_name: Centralized Audit Log Management Not Implemented
description: Audit logs are not centrally collected, managed, or analyzed. This signal indicates that log data may be fragmented across systems, making correlation and incident detection difficult.
applicability: Applicable to all organizations with multiple systems generating audit logs. Includes SIEM solutions, log aggregation platforms, and centralized log management systems.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through log management architecture review, SIEM deployment assessment, and log forwarding configuration verification.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 - Audit and Accountability
32 CFR Part 170 - Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification Program
